question: Where is the nearest attraction situated on the way toward Quality Inn Chillicothe, Chillicothe, OH from Denison Biological Reserve / Polly Anderson Field Station, Granville, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.52007 40.084033)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.977969 39.350261)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'attraction'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.52007 40.084033)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.52007 40.084033)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Denison Biological Reserve / Polly Anderson Field Station, Granville, OH

poi.poi_name: Denison Biological Reserve / Polly Anderson Field Station
